conditions.brightness: Original fixed value 1191 retained; automatic brightness off
conditions.refresh: Original peak_refresh_rate=60 retained; min refresh unset; adaptive idle refresh remains enabled
conditions.network: Wi-Fi ADB; existing radio/background app state retained
conditions.power: BatteryManager CURRENT_NOW times broadcast voltage, 250 ms integration; whole-device draw, not app-only
conditions.memory: External dumpsys meminfo TOTAL PSS and Private Dirty+Private Clean; associated isolated WebView process included using ActivityManager packageList. In-app PSS omits graphics accounting and private is Pss_Anon, absent on this Android 12 device.

conditions.optimization: Zig ReleaseFast; signed Gradle release arm64-v8a APKs
conditions.repeats: One fresh process per mode for power. One full GUI suite per mode for memory, two snapshots of that process, not independent repeated trials.
conditions.power_method: Power-only mode; fixed visible 320x240 logical pixels; results deferred until completion. Requested 60 seconds/scenario. BatteryManager current times voltage, approximately 250 ms integration. Whole-device draw.
conditions.memory_method: External dumpsys meminfo TOTAL PSS; Private Dirty+Private Clean. ActivityManager packageList identifies main app and its isolated WebView renderer. Done screenshots checked. Queries separate from power.
conditions.memory_endpoints: Oriel approximately 48/54 seconds after start; native/WebView approximately 60/76 seconds. All completed the suite. A later Oriel repeat went black and was rejected. Endpoint timing/cache reclamation limits precise native/Oriel attribution.
conditions.display: Original fixed brightness 1191, peak 60 Hz and adaptive idle refresh retained. Wireless ADB, no charger.
conditions.instrumentation: Logcat polled every 10 seconds; charger checked periodically; viewport screenshot during Oriel canvas.

memory.method: One GUI full suite; external memory after 48 and 54 seconds, after completion; isolated processes identified by ActivityManager packageList. Queries separate from power tests.

limits: Single pass in fixed order; no confidence interval; includes screen/radios/background apps. Thermal/background states differ.

Native JS standard canvas took 80.2 seconds for a 60-second request; cause uninvestigated. Average watts/FPS cover the whole scenario, including preparation/cleanup. Do not compare total joules as equal-duration work or infer steady-state FPS.
Charge counter changes in approximately 39,920 uAh steps; zero delta does not mean zero energy.
In-app PSS omits graphics accounting visible externally. private_mb actually reads Pss_Anon, unavailable on this Android 12 device and shown as zero. In-app fields are not used as total memory.
Primary canvas is JavaScript in native/WebView, Zig f64 physics in Oriel. Shared direct Zig variant uses existing f32 code.
Declarative and HTML/table UI shells differ. These measure whole scenarios, not isolated interpreter costs.
Memory endpoints differ slightly and ranges overlap for native/Oriel; avoid a precise improvement percentage.
rejected_attempts: Initial native power attempt with shrinking/partly clipped viewport aborted.
Final Oriel memory repeat black; earlier visible Done snapshots retained.

validation.host_power_only: Both native modes completed four unavailable-source scenarios; viewport metadata 320x240.
validation.apk: All three release APKs passed apksigner verification, same certificate as original app.
